text:
nina: Heads-up — planning to promote a subset of payments charts to prod in the EU change window tomorrow 02:00-04:00 UTC. Staged promotion order: auth -> gateway -> billing. Will include a tiny hotfix for gateway image tag. Any concerns?
devon: +1. Are we overriding values or relying on chart defaults? last canary had CPU bump.
maria: We need to pin chart versions for rollback safety. current prod is payments-auth 1.8.2, gateway 2.3.0, billing 0.9.5. Target for gateway is 2.4.0-rc1 (contains hotfix). If anything flakey, plan is immediate rollback to 2.3.0.
samir: For the gateway hotfix, do a 5% canary first (1 replica in canary pool), wait 10m, then 25%, then 100%. If errors >5% or any steady-state latency spike in APM, stop and roll back.
deploy-bot: Deploy queued: payments/gateway 2.4.0-rc1 -> prod (canary=5%) scheduled by nina at 2026-03-20T02:10:00Z. To cancel, react with :x:.
opsbot: Reminder: change window policy requires annotating the namespace to prevent cross-namespace evictions. Run: 
```
kubectl annotate namespace payments release-window=eu-0200-0400 --overwrite
```
Also add release guard: 
```
kubectl annotate namespace payments release.redwood.io/protected=true --overwrite
```
This prevents autoscaler-driven evictions during rollout.
nina: I'll run the annotations 30m before start. For values: gateway needs replicas=4 -> replicas=2 during canary and traffic shaping via envoy. I'll supply the values override file in the release notes bundle.
devon: Make sure the values override is a minimal patch. Example: 
```
# values-canary.yaml
replicaCount: 2
resources:
  requests:
    cpu: 100m
    memory: 200Mi
```
maria: Also note the billing chart has a CRD change in 1.0.0-beta. We'll skip billing if CRD migration hasn't landed in the cluster. Gate: if crd.paymentplans.v1alpha1 missing -> skip billing promotion and file a follow-up.
samir: Rollback playbook reminder: 
- Step 1: deploy-bot abort canary and pin chart versions back via helm rollback to previous release name
- Step 2: scale gateway back to previous replicaCount if needed
- Step 3: open incident channel and attach canary logs
I'll add the exact helm commands to the runbook.
nina: Helm command I'll run for canary: 
```
helm upgrade payments-gateway ./charts/gateway 
  --install 
  -f values-prod.yaml -f values-canary.yaml 
  --set image.tag=2026-03-19-hotfix-rc1 
  --wait --timeout 5m
```
If it succeeds at 5% -> scale to 25% with the same command and different weight.
maria: I'll draft release notes and include the values-diff and rollback instructions under docs/release-notes/payments-2026-03-20.md. Nina, can you drop the final values-canary.yaml in the PR?
nina: yes, will push a tiny PR after annotations. tagging @devon for verification.
devon: will verify the override and smoke test the /health and /v1/pay endpoints in canary pool.
deploy-bot: Canary progressed to 5% at 2026-03-20T02:12:30Z. Monitoring hooks active.
opsbot: If we see imagepullbackoff, follow the immediate rollback path: 
```
helm rollback payments-gateway 1 
kubectl rollout status deployment/payments-gateway -n payments
```
maria: ack. I'll be on-call for the window and will assemble the final release notes once we hit 100% or roll back.
samir: tagging test:alert-on-call so SREs get paged if latency >250ms for 3m.
nina: thanks all. Will post a short postmortem in #postmortems if anything messy happens. :thumbsup:
